summary: Jefferies Financial Group Inc. filed a 424B5 pricing supplement for a $5.169 million offering of Senior Fixed Rate 5-Year Callable Notes due June 30, 2031, at an issue price of 100% ($1,000 per Note). The notes carry a 5.50% semi-annual coupon and are callable annually starting June 30, 2027. Jefferies LLC acts as agent. Net proceeds of $5,143,155 are for general corporate purposes. This is a routine debt shelf takedown under Rule 424(b)(5) with no special-situation dynamics. No deal terms apply; the offering is a standard capital markets transaction.
